name: Poulan Pro PR5020
blurb: 50.2 cc Poulan Pro: a single 20″ factory setup, 3/8″ pitch, .050″ gauge — the manual does not print a drive-link count, so we flag it.
intro: The Poulan Pro PR5020 is a 50.2 cc saw whose operator's manual (May 2016) lists one approved cutting attachment: a 20″ bar (578133803) with chain 545196401, on 3/8″ pitch with .050″ (1.3 mm) drive-link thickness. The manual stops short of printing a drive-link count or file size, and we won't back one out of a part number — so this page gives you the sourced pitch, gauge and part numbers and tells you to read the count off your bar stamp.

bars.note: Per the operator's manual: 20″ bar 578133803, chain 545196401, pitch 3/8″, drive-link thickness .050″. Drive-link count is not stated in the manual.

sources.title: Operator's manual PR5020 (967061501, May 2016): chain/bar specification and guide bar and saw chain combinations
